label: billing
subject: Refund window
body: How many days after I first subscribe can I still ask for a refund?
expected_answer: Refunds are available within 14 days of the first charge on a new subscription.

label: billing
subject: Cheaper if I pay yearly?
body: If we commit for a whole year up front instead of paying every month, do we save anything?
expected_answer: Yes. Annual billing on the Team and Business plans is 20 percent cheaper.

label: billing
subject: Payment date in short months
body: I started my subscription on the 31st. What happens in months that don't have a 31st, when do you take the money?
expected_answer: The charge falls on the last day of that month.

label: billing
subject: BIL-409 when renewing
body: My renewal didn't go through and the page shows BIL-409. What does that mean?
expected_answer: BIL-409 means the card has expired.

label: billing
subject: Switching to a smaller plan
body: If I move from Business down to Team today, does the lower price start right away?
expected_answer: No. A downgrade takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle.

label: troubleshooting
subject: Password reset link expired
body: How long is the password reset link valid? I clicked it this morning and it didn't work.
expected_answer: The reset link is valid for 60 minutes and can only be used once.

label: troubleshooting
subject: SYN-409 on my laptop
body: The desktop app keeps showing SYN-409 after I edited a record on my phone too. Did I lose my changes?
expected_answer: SYN-409 is a conflict from editing the same record in two places. Both versions are kept and the newer one is marked primary.

label: troubleshooting
subject: Locked out, AUTH-423
body: I typed my password wrong a few times and now I get AUTH-423. How long until I can try again?
expected_answer: AUTH-423 means the account is locked after five failed attempts. The lock clears automatically after 15 minutes.

label: troubleshooting
subject: Lost my phone
body: My phone with the code-generator app was stolen. How do I get back into my account?
expected_answer: Use one of the ten recovery codes. If all are used, the account owner must email support@example.com from the registered address for identity verification, which takes 2 to 3 business days.

label: troubleshooting
subject: File upload failing
body: What's the biggest file I can upload? My 40 MB PDF keeps failing.
expected_answer: The maximum file size is 25 MB, so a 40 MB PDF is too large.

label: accounts
subject: Invitation expired
body: I sent an invite to a colleague two weeks ago and the link no longer works. Can I extend it?
expected_answer: Invitations expire after 7 days and cannot be extended. It must be resent.

label: accounts
subject: Parcel to Germany
body: I ordered the device yesterday. Roughly how long until it reaches me in Munich, and what does the faster option cost?
expected_answer: Standard EU delivery takes 3 to 5 business days for 9 euros. Express takes 1 to 2 business days for 24 euros.

label: accounts
subject: Colleague left the company
body: We took someone off our workspace yesterday. What happens to all the records they created?
expected_answer: Their records stay in the workspace and are reassigned to the owner. The removed user loses access immediately.

label: accounts
subject: Returning unopened hardware
body: The box hasn't been opened. Can I still send it back, and what do I need to do first?
expected_answer: Yes, within 30 days of delivery. First email hardware@example.com for a return authorisation number; returns without it are refused.
